steps.title: The engine's own behaviours
steps.body: Locks, switches, push blocks, health: the engine's own features are behaviours too, built in. An asset with that setting is one. You can read what each does, set its fields, and extend it: make your own that changes one of its decisions. Here: a crate you can push only twice before it sticks.

steps.title: Read about Pushable
steps.body: Under Built-in (left), press Pushable. Its page says what it does, its field (Can be pulled too), its hook canPush(e) (the decision: can it move this way now?) and the event it sends.

steps.title: Extend it
steps.body: Press Extend. You get My Pushable: class MyPushable extends Pushable, with canPush(e) answered by return super.canPush(e) (the engine's own answer). Change it in Code: a Pushes field, a moved count, and once it has moved that often, log a line and return false.

code: pushes = field.number(2, { label: "Pushes before it sticks", min: 1, max: 20 });

steps.title: A crate
steps.body: In the Scene, place a Wooden crate a few studs ahead of the start.

steps.title: Put it on the crate
steps.body: Select the crate and attach My Pushable with + Script (Every Wooden crate). Because it extends Pushable, the crate becomes a Pushable as well: the Inspector lists the built-in above your behaviour.
steps.task: Attach My Pushable to the Wooden crate.

steps.title: A built-in's field
steps.body: In the Pushable row, tick Can be pulled too. That is the same setting as Assets › Puzzle › Push: a built-in's fields are its settings.
steps.task: Let the crate be pulled too.

steps.title: Push it
steps.body: Press Play. Hold the Action button at the crate and walk into it: it slides. Push it again: it slides. The third time it will not move, and the Console says it is stuck fast.
steps.task: Press Play and push the crate three times.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You extended a built-in: your behaviour answered one of its decisions (canPush) and let the engine answer otherwise (super.canPush). The others work the same: Lock.canOpen (a door that needs three gems), Health.takeDamage (a tough crate that takes half of every hit), Switch.isPressed, Pickup.canPickUp, Climbable.canClimb, Interactable.canUse.
